title: Linear depletion broken: rewardPerSecond is re-anchored on every interaction, causing asymptotic (not linear) reward emission
rootCause: After each accrual step in `_updatePool` the rate is recomputed as `rewardPerSecond = (rewardBalance * PRECISION) / depletionDuration` using the post-accrual (decreased) `rewardBalance`. Because this happens on every block that has a stake/withdraw/claim/collectReward/setDepletionDuration call, the depletion window is effectively reset on every interaction. The protocol's stated property (`rewardBalance` is fully distributed over `depletionDuration` seconds at a constant `rewardPerSecond`) does not hold: instead `rewardBalance` decays as `rewardBalance_{n+1} ~= rewardBalance_n * (1 - Δt/depletionDuration)`, i.e. exponentially with a heavy tail that never reaches zero.
impact: Stakers receive materially less reward token than designed. Over a full `depletionDuration` of continuous interaction, only a fraction (~1 - 1/e at the smooth limit) of `rewardBalance` is actually distributed; the remainder lingers indefinitely. Reward funders pay full notional but only a fraction is consumed in the intended window. Also affects `pendingStable()` and `collectReward`'s rate publication.
attackVector: No malicious actor required. Triggered by normal usage: any caller invoking `_updatePool` (directly via `collectReward` or indirectly via `stake`/`withdraw`/`claim`/`setDepletionDuration`) re-anchors the window. Worst case: a third party calling `collectReward(1 wei)` repeatedly amplifies the asymptotic behaviour further.
steps: Caller pokes `_updatePool` (via any of stake/withdraw/claim) every block.
After 7 days, `rewardBalance` is roughly `1_000_000e6 / e ~= 368_000e6`, not zero.
Stakers have received ~632_000e6 instead of the expected 1_000_000e6 over the advertised window; the remainder remains stuck and continues to decay asymptotically.
knownIssueReference: lib/phlimbo-ea/CLAUDE.md: 'src/Phlimbo.sol -- PhlimboEA (V1, deployed). Linear-depletion staking yield farm. Has the V1 rate-recompute bug ... DO NOT MODIFY.' Profile §7 V1 / §12 routing hint flags this for ledger dedup.
remediation: Remove the rate recompute from `_updatePool` (the V2 fix). Either freeze `rewardPerSecond` at the value set by `collectReward`/`setDepletionDuration` and let `rewardBalance` deplete linearly with the cap on `toDistribute`, or refactor to a streaming-rate model.
notesToDedup: Already documented as the known V1 behavior. Sanitizer should suppress against the CLAUDE.md known-issue note. Listed here for ledger completeness.
